title: Noosa's visitors

points: Noosa Shire has only about 54,000 residents, but over 2 million visitors a year.
About 1.5 million come from within Queensland, around 400,000 from other states and around 100,000 from overseas.
That's about the same number of visitors as the Great Barrier Reef. Australia's top destination is the Sydney Opera House, with about 11 million a year.

sources: Moved from Local facts for a chat (EO-TR-10, then EO-TR-14 Being a tour guide), 12/11/2026.
